newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mixed, gas oil awaits IPE expiry.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mixed, gas oil awaits IPE expiry.

text.p: Nwe oil products were mixed on Tuesday, with most drawing support from crude's bounce.
Gas oil gained up to $5 a tonne on the back of rising futures and steady premiums. Activity was slow ahead of the expiry of the Feb contract tomorrow.
High sulphur cracked fuel oil barges were notionally slightly weaker, but prices were still volatile.
Naphtha swaps and physical prices edged higher on continued tightness in prompt, pipeline spec material.
Gasoline rose with crude but a jump in European supplies and closed arbitrage put the bears on the prowl.
